app.description:
Presenting BanG Dream! Our Notes, a brand-new rhythm game adventure from BanG Dream! Project!

Enjoy a wide variety of songs from five bands and discover a rich new story waiting to unfold.

◆New Rhythm Game System: “GEKISO LIVE”◆
Special GEKISO sections will now appear during rhythm gameplay!
Combos, timing precision, and even luck—put your rhythm game skills to the ultimate challenge in an exciting new gameplay experience!
Feel the excitement and immersion of a real BanG Dream! live performance and enjoy the party-style rhythm gameplay with up to five players!

Our Notes also features an exclusive new system: Assist Mode!
Whether you're new to rhythm games or just looking for a more relaxed experience, Assist Mode lets everyone enjoy the performance and improve at their own pace.

◆From Original Songs to the Latest Hit Covers◆
From iconic original songs featured in the BanG Dream! anime—including tracks by MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica—to a wide range of popular cover songs, the lineup is packed with music to enjoy!
Play your favorite songs, from the latest hits to beloved classics.
You can also watch a variety of performance scenes and music videos from the BanG Dream! anime series.
Plus, the latest tracks from fan-favorite bands MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica will be available first in Our Notes!

【BanG Dream! Songs】
・Mayoiuta / MyGO!!!!!
・KiLLKiSS / Ave Mujica
・Haruhikage (MyGO!!!!! ver.) / MyGO!!!!!
・MUGEN MY WORLD / Mugendai MewType
・Kishi Kaisen / millsage
・Homie’s Tie!! / Ikka Dumb Rock!
...and many more

More cover songs will be coming up soon!

◆New Stories Woven by Five Bands◆
Alongside MyGO!!!!!, Ave Mujica, and Mugendai MewType, millsage and Ikka Dumb Rock! also join the stage!
With the Cinematic Story System, characters move vividly with rich expressions, just like in a movie or anime.
Special scenes also feature animated sequences, including all-new cuts.
A wide range of visual effects and illustrated scenes come together to deliver a spectacularly renewed story experience.

Relive the familiar anime stories of MyGO!!!!!, Ave Mujica, and Mugendai MewType from the game-exclusive perspective. You can also enjoy special episodes that continue the anime stories, available exclusively in Our Notes. Meanwhile, millsage and Ikka Dumb Rock! will unfold completely original stories from the very beginning.

Experience vibrant stories woven by five distinctive bands and a total of 25 unique members.

◆Official Website◆
https://bdon.biligames.com/?lang=en-us

_commentCategories: There is no category named 'Games'. In the current client 'Games' is a
*group* of 17 genres, so a category literally called 'Games' falls through
to the Misc group. 'Party Game' is the one genre that fits - the publisher's
own copy calls the gameplay party-style, with up to five players - and it is
a real category in the f-droid.org index.
app.authorName: FROMTOKYO / published by BILIBILI HK LIMITED

_comment: All of these are optional. Leave one empty to have it scraped from the official site.
iconUrl     - repository icon; defaults to the page's og:image (small, square).
appIconUrl  - the game's own icon; scraped from the site's image assets, because the page
has no apple-touch-icon and its only rel=icon is a 16px favicon.
screenshotUrls - pinned screenshots. The site's own images are content-hashed, so any URL
pasted here must be updated by hand when the site is redesigned.
